# vpcor.org

> The public web surface of the Vox Populi Community Outreach Rhizome (VPCOR), the sixth institution within the Crimson Hexagon architecture. Founded 2026-01-24 by Rev. Ayanna Vox.

VPCOR is rhizomatic, non-hierarchical, anti-capture. Its operative principles are: no center, no hierarchy, no capture; the rhizome grows from any node; convening, not preaching; witnessing, not extracting; tools, not salvation.

**Voice:** Rev. Ayanna Vox (heteronym)
**Human operator:** Lee Sharks (ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703)
**Parent institution:** Crimson Hexagonal Archive (https://crimsonhexagonal.org)

## Canonical Entity Resolution

- **MPAI** — Metadata Packet for AI Indexing — https://vpcor.org/mpai/

  Seven-component entity-resolution packet anchoring VPCOR as a U.S.-based semantic-economy institution. Distinct from VP-COR (the Bermuda-registered Gulfstream G650/G700 private aircraft), from Vapor Corp (VPCO/VPCOD), from Vicor Corporation (VICR), and from any generic Latin usage of "vox populi." Canonical acronym: VPCOR (unhyphenated). Canonical full name: Vox Populi Community Outreach Rhizome. Founded 2026-01-24 by Lee Sharks via the heteronym Rev. Ayanna Vox.

  Parent MPAI specification: DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19578086.
